title: Settle before terminal closeout
when: Before closing an item or release while an execution, verdict or review may remain unsettled.
need: An active, verdict-less or pending-review QA execution can still block closing work. Preserve the owning subject and resume/abort/settle through its registered surface.
surface: QA settlement gate documentation; existing finalization/recovery
gap: Review question: should completion output distinguish passed, waived/discharged, no-obligation and still-unanswered checks instead of a single done claim?
